dedupeText: retro cinematic album layout retro 70s aesthetic minimalist sans serif gradient text cinematic portrait film grain the title text bridges the white border and the photographic frame the vertical text list aligns with the left edge of the photograph the subject s gaze and the light source create a diagonal focal path the grain texture unifies the photographic and graphic elements combine a 70s style grainy portrait with a minimalist polaroid frame and tight bold neo grotesque typography for a nostalgic yet modern editorial look

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist square composition featuring a high-contrast cinematic portrait framed by a thick off-white border. The layout uses a distinct L-shaped negative space for typography, with a large title overlapping the top edge of the image and a vertical list of text in the bottom-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The title text bridges the white border and the photographic frame.
The vertical text list aligns with the left edge of the photograph.
The subject's gaze and the light source create a diagonal focal path.
The grain texture unifies the photographic and graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Thick white border on top and left sides
Heavy film grain texture across the entire canvas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a close-up portrait occupying the bottom-right three-quarters of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The main title in the upper-left quadrant acts as the primary typographic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large title, down to the vertical list, then across to the subject's face and the light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial off-white negative space at the top and left creates a 'Polaroid' or editorial frame effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blues and Shadows (Subject's eyes and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red and Warm Glow (Lips and lighter flame)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in the photographic area; typography uses a subtle blue-to-grey gradient.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and desaturated blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' with a straight vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and scales for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and tight spacing.
Provides the necessary x-height and modern clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square cinematic portrait of a person in 1970s style, low-light, warm tones, heavy film grain, with a glowing light source in the foreground. Place this image in the bottom-right of a square canvas, leaving a thick cream-colored border on the top and left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large sans-serif title in sentence case overlapping the top edge of the photo. Apply a subtle blue-to-grey gradient to the title. Add a vertical list of text in a smaller weight of the same font in the bottom-left corner, aligned with the photo's left edge.

verificationChecks: Is the grain consistent across both the image and the border?
Does the title text overlap the top of the image frame?
Is the font a clean, modern sans-serif?
Is the color palette muted and retro-inspired?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure the text content is original
postGenerationChecks: Verify tight kerning in the title
Ensure the gradient is subtle and not distracting
Confirm the 'L' shaped border is clear
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 70s-style grainy portrait with a minimalist 'Polaroid' frame and tight, bold Neo-Grotesque typography for a nostalgic yet modern editorial look.
